content:
If you're like me, you know the feeling of spending too much time on Wikipedia clicking through random articles. Now there's finally an official app, no, should say widget for that.

There's finally a button that can open a random Wikipedia article

Today's Wikipedia iOS app update added a fun and practical new feature: a random article widget that can be placed on the iPhone and iPad home screen.

It comes in two sizes (small and medium) and has a cute mascot.

Tap the widget and it will take you to a completely random Wikipedia article and turn on random mode for you.

No need to leave the app and tap the widget again. Just tap the random button and it will keep taking you deeper into this random maze, like rolling dice.

Have fun, but be careful not to lose track of time! Earlier this summer, the Wikipedia app also added a history trivia game.

You can find this new widget in today's updated Wikipedia iPhone and iPad app.
